faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UCSL Supervisor (Mechanical) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the UCSL Supervisor (Mechanical) post is 08 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Supervisor (Mechanical) at UCSL?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Supervisor (Mechanical) post in Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited. These positions are on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for UCSL Supervisor (Mechanical) posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the UCSL Supervisor (Mechanical) recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website to complete the registration and application process.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Supervisor (Mechanical) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Supervisor (Mechanical) post is 45 years as of 08 October 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for OBC, SC/ST, and Ex-servicemen categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Supervisor (Mechanical)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or an ITI (NTC) in relevant trades like Welding, Sheet metal worker, Fitter, or Plumber from a recognized institute.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for UCSL Supervisor (Mechanical)?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay ranges from Rs. 40,650/- per month in the first year, progressively increasing to Rs. 44,164/- per month by the fifth year of the contract period.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying the application fee for the UCSL Supervisor (Mechanical) recruitment. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 300.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Supervisor (Mechanical) at UCSL?
faq.answer: The selection process involves two phases: a Written Test (Objective and Descriptive) for 80 marks, followed by a Power Point Presentation on work experience for 20 marks.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be found on the official websites of Cochin Shipyard Limited (www.cochinshipyard.in) or Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited (www.udupicsl.com) under the career section.

faq.question: Q10. What kind of experience is required for this post?
faq.answer: Diploma holders need a minimum of 7 years post-qualification experience, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role. ITI holders require 15 years experience, with 3 years in a supervisory capacity, in relevant engineering fields.
